notes: Held-out plan added 2026-10-29 to test generalisation: a scanned 2007 community action plan (JPEG 2000 images, no text layer) written as numbered strategy lists, unlike any tuning plan. Drafted by Claude from the page images, page by page, before any extraction of this plan was run; quotes are transcribed by eye, so the verbatim and quote checks do not apply. Labelled on the purpose page and the action plan (pages 15-18). Items of the education strategies are outreach; protection, restoration and organisational strategies are activities, except where an item is itself an education or participation event.
